checkpoint: Best checkpoint selected by the original training validation metric, not by test and not reselected using the later per-image export.
group_policy: Patient/group IDs must come from documented metadata; unknown IDs stay unknown. Do not label image IDs as patients.

metric_definition.target: Final prepared binary mask; same evaluation preprocessing for every strategy.
metric_definition.stored_precision: Unrounded numeric values; rounding only for final presentation.

canonical_export_policy: Tables, figures and paired tests must use the same versioned per-image export. Re-inference creates a new version rather than silently replacing one consumer's data.

ood.models: Retain all seeds of baseline, single-best, best TrivialAugment, best RandAugment.
ood.export: Per-image Dice/IoU and pixel counts on each planned target test split, with source/target dataset, strategy, seed and target patient/group IDs.
ood.comparison: Paired on identical target images; never choose models from target test performance.
